prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1325; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain and low back pain with associated muscle stiffness and limited range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported incident, and the presenting complaints are plausible for this type of impact. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical and lumbar motion, and imaging findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury consistent with cervical and lumbar strain. No prior injury or treatment to the same body regions is known to this provider. Care consisted of ten visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Billed services reflect the treatment rendered, with no repeated charges for the same service. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
